newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo tender,16.5 pct max.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 1-wk rev repo tender,16.5 pct max.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Tuesday set a one-week reverse repo tender to drain market liquidity at a maximum rate of 16.5 percent, down from 17 percent in a similar operation on Monday.
The CNB said in a statement that it would accept a maximum of two bids from each participants at a minimum of 100 million crowns per bid until 10.20 a.m. (0820 GMT).
Earlier on Tuesday, average yield in the CNB's two-week reverse repo hit 16.49 percent.
